meta.intent: An intelligent operating system for serious businesses.
meta.not: Another AI startup trying to look futuristic.
meta.logo: Do not design or imply a logo. Use the word Zephrok in Source Sans 3 semibold.

ember.usage: Recognition only: spine, one primary action fill when using ember-strong, chart series 1, focus ring. Never small text.

emberStrong.usage: Primary buttons and any orange+white text. WCAG AA 5.52:1 on white.

emberTint.usage: Selected row, active nav wash, subtle highlight. Max 8% of a view.

emberSoft.usage: Progress track, chart fill under a line. Not a background.

ink.usage: Primary text, icons default, key numbers.

ink3.usage: Captions, timestamps, placeholders. AA on paper.

paper.usage: Canvas / page background. Warm ledger, never cool gray.

surface.usage: Raised working surface: sheets, popovers, input fields.

sunken.usage: Inset wells, code/id chips, disabled fills.

line.usage: Hairline rules, table rows, form borders.

ok.usage: Posted, applied, paid, resolved. Text + icon. Not mint.

okTint.usage: Success wash behind a short status.

warn.usage: Draft, waiting, needs review. Distinct from ember.

err.usage: Failed, declined, forbidden. Never joke around this.

info.usage: Informational, system notes. Slate, not AI blue.

umber.usage: Chart series, photography grade. Supporting, not status.

ember.usage: Recognition on dark. AA vs dark paper.

emberStrong.usage: Primary button fill on dark. Pair with ink (#1C1917) text, not white.

serif.name: Source Serif 4
serif.fallback: Source Serif Pro, Iowan Old Style, Georgia, serif
serif.role: Marketing display and brand-book titles only.

sans.name: Source Sans 3
sans.fallback: Source Sans Pro, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
sans.role: Product UI, body, tables, navigation, alerts, AI copy.

mono.name: IBM Plex Mono
mono.role: IDs, SKUs, timestamps, audit keys, policy names. Never money.
